title: The Records page is never tested empty, failing, or tapped
what: No test shows 'No records yet', 'Couldn't load your records' or its try again, and no test taps a record to open its exercise and come back to the same place in the list.
expected: A test for a new member sees 'No records yet', a test with a failed read sees the load error and not 'No records yet', and a test taps a record and returns to the list.
fix_line: Add a device test for the empty, failed and tapped Records page

title: The month report's arrows, its load error and its gym switch are never tested
what: No test taps the previous or next month arrows, checks they grey out at the first and current month, makes the report fail to load, or turns 'Your gym on the picture' off for a report picture. The empty-month words are checked only as text, never on screen.
expected: A device test moves between months with the arrows, sees them greyed at the ends, sees 'Couldn't load this report' with try again, and hides the gym on the report picture.
fix_line: Add a device test that walks the month arrows and a failed report

title: Renaming, copying and deleting a routine, and the routine editor's errors, are never tested
what: 'Delete routine' is only seen in the menu, never tapped. No test renames a routine, copies it to another folder, or sees 'Couldn't save your last change', 'Routine not found', 'No exercises yet' or 'Leave without saving?'.
expected: A device test renames, copies and deletes a routine and checks history stays; a test makes a routine save fail and sees the change kept with 'Try again'.
fix_line: Add device tests for routine rename, copy, delete and a failed save

title: Deleting a saved workout, its photo limit and its load errors are never tested
what: No test taps 'Delete workout', sees 'Delete this workout?', or checks the workout and its records leave the feed. No test sees 'Workout not found', 'Couldn't load this workout', a failed delete, the 'needs at least one set' line, or the fourth-photo limit.
expected: A device test deletes a saved workout and checks the feed and Records; tests make the page read and the delete fail and see the right words.
fix_line: Add device tests for deleting a saved workout and its failure words

title: The finish summary's photo, share and error words are never tested
what: No test adds a photo on the finish summary, shares from it, or checks the kg-lifted card and its one line. 'Nothing to save', 'Summary unavailable' and an error in the exercise picker are never shown in a test; Finish being blocked with nothing ticked is not checked.
expected: A device test finishes a workout, reads the summary card line, adds a photo and shares; tests check Finish is blocked with nothing ticked and 'Summary unavailable' shows with Done.
fix_line: Add device checks for the summary card, its photo and share, and the finish errors

title: Ask an AI is never tested empty, failing, or copied
what: Only the happy page is driven. No test shows 'No workouts in the last 4 weeks' with no share button, 'Couldn't read your workouts', 'Couldn't open sharing', or copying the text.
expected: Tests open Ask an AI with no recent workouts and with a failed read, and check the words and that there is no share button.
fix_line: Add a test for the empty and failed Ask an AI page

title: No test proves records, routines, workouts and Ask an AI send nothing to the gym or an AI
what: Only the words of shared text are checked. No test records what leaves the phone when Records, a routine, a finished workout or its photos are used with trainer sharing off, when the coach switch is off, or that a help question goes without the member's phone number.
expected: A test per screen watches outgoing requests and finds none to the gym or an AI with sharing and coach off, and no phone number in a help message.
fix_line: Add tests that record outgoing requests from these screens

title: No test double-taps the buttons that save, start or share on these screens
what: Saving the first routine, starting a routine, adding an exercise, finishing, swapping, saving as a routine, sharing and sending help are each tapped once in tests. Nothing checks a fast double tap makes only one routine, workout, summary or message.
expected: A device test double-taps each of these buttons and finds one result.
fix_line: Add a double-tap check to the device tests of these buttons

title: Records, the month report and Ask an AI are never tested to update after a workout is added or deleted
what: The counting rules are tested, but no test keeps one of these pages open, logs or deletes a workout, and checks the page changes without a restart.
expected: A device test logs and then deletes a workout and checks Records, this month's report and Ask an AI change each time.
fix_line: Add a device test that changes workouts while these pages are open
